title: Necrosis
lyrics:
[00:42.38]Crumble (Crumble beneath me)
[00:49.02]Your pain (Caused me to feel)
[00:56.78]I leave Earth to ask you (To ask you)
[01:13.86]Ask you why you failed
[01:27.00]You're fading to blue
[01:49.34]I'd hope to see you (I'll see you)
[01:56.02]Up in the clouds (Up in the clouds)
[02:02.69]I leave Earth to ask you (To ask you)
[02:20.80]Ask you why you failed
[02:34.02]You're fading to blue
